**Finding: deviation (high severity) — NONCOMPETE**

The duplicate-numbered § 12.4 (p0046) imposes on us a non-compete covering development, marketing, sale, and acquisition of *any* product or service competing with Vendor, in *any* territory, running 24 months past termination. That breaches the walk-away line twice over — undefined scope and a post-term tail beyond 12 months — and it flatly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete p0046 in full and rely on § 12.3, which already preserves our freedom of action.

**Comment delivered:** we cannot restrict our business; if Vendor needs protection for a specific offering, we signalled the fallback (single named competing product, term only, 12-month cap, carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions).
